title: Surreal Broccoli Dreamscape
description: A massive green broccoli tree dominates the center of a surreal landscape. From its crown emerge melting clocks, screaming female faces with long pink serpentine hair, a giant open mouth with red lips containing a gothic tower, bats, a melting Dali-style clock, a purple 8-ball, and a large yellow butterfly with eyes on its wings.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape featuring an enormous broccoli tree growing from a medieval village. The broccoli head contains screaming female faces with long flowing pink tentacle hair, a giant open red mouth with a gothic tower inside, melting Dali clocks, bats flying around, a purple 8-ball, and a large yellow butterfly with eyes on its wings. Psychedelic sky with purple and yellow clouds, grotesque and whimsical elements, highly detailed digital painting.
